transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before we finalize the communications annex, I want to confirm a few things in our huddle. We have two portable relay kits available -- Kit A and Kit B. Both the northern liaison site and the southern command post need a relay kit from 0800 through 1600 today. I need to verify equipment status on both kits and confirm there are no maintenance actions pending before I sign the annex and assign them. Has anyone identified any issues with either kit, or are there any changes to the site requirements we should be aware of?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, there's a requirement that hasn't been added to the communications annex yet. The northern liaison site must use the approved interoperability module installed in Kit B -- Kit A cannot connect to the partner network there. I received the liaison support confirmation yesterday, but the requirement hasn't yet been reflected in the annex. This means Kit B needs to be assigned to the northern liaison site, and Kit A to the southern command post.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a maintenance issue with Kit B that hasn't been posted to the equipment status board yet. I verified the battery log this morning -- Kit B's installed battery pack is only certified for four hours, from 0800 through 1200. We have a replacement pack staged at the commo shop, but it requires a 15-minute battery swap at 1200. So Kit B will have a brief maintenance window at noon today. Given that Capt. Brooks just indicated Kit B needs to go to the northern liaison site, we need to account for that 1200 battery swap in the plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Good information from both of you. So to summarize what I'm hearing: Kit B must go to the northern liaison site because it has the approved interoperability module required for the partner network there -- Kit A won't work at that site. That means Kit A goes to the southern command post. However, Kit B has a battery issue -- the installed pack is only certified through 1200, so we need a 15-minute battery swap at noon. SFC Tan, can you confirm who will perform the swap at the northern liaison site and whether there's any impact to communications during that 15-minute window? I want to make sure we capture this maintenance window in the annex before I sign it.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I can speak to the operational impact of that 15-minute window. Since Kit B is the only kit that can connect to the partner network at the northern liaison site, there's no redundant relay capability to cover the swap -- communications with the partner network will be temporarily interrupted during those 15 minutes at noon. We should note that in the annex as a planned communications gap so the northern liaison team and the partner network are both notified in advance. I'll make sure the liaison team is aware and can plan any critical coordination around that window. As for who performs the swap, that's SFC Tan's lane, so I'll defer to him on the specifics.
transcript.speaker: A2
